objective: Show that a symmetric three-place relation glues topologically with counts exactly when f0 f2 + f1 f3 = f1^2 + f2^2, which is the generalized Fibonacci-gate recurrence or a generalized equality; among the 34 knots this selects exactly the four topological knots, whose native counts with pins follow closed formulas; classify every knot against the tractable families of Backens's Holant dichotomy with pins, so that counting is #P-hard for the other 30 knots given the cited dichotomy.
status: Proved by NATIVE-COUNTING-20261024-001A-P001 (V1 prose proof with standard-library check; hardness conditional on Backens's Holant dichotomy). The topological gluing criterion is the generalized Fibonacci-gate recurrence f0 f2 + f1 f3 = f1^2 + f2^2; the four topological knots are sums of two orthonormal cubes and count by closed formulas (2^g; Verlinde dimensions) in polynomial time, while the other 30 knots lie in no tractable family, so their native counting is #P-hard: emergence is countable exactly when it is topological.
title: Emergence is countable exactly when it is topological
